storyCards.headline: Lucky Man: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Emerson, Lake's "Lucky Man" reached #48 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #48 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

Lucky Man was released in 1971.

Chart story — peaked at #48 on the Hot 100.
